mapper.select: SELECT ID, TITLE, AUTHOR, TRANSLATOR, STARTED_ON, COMPLETED_ON, CONTENT, RATING, NOTES FROM WORK_READING_RECORD WHERE WORK_USER_NO = #{owner} ORDER BY ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WORK_READING_RECORD (WORK_USER_NO, TITLE, AUTHOR, TRANSLATOR, STARTED_ON, COMPLETED_ON, CONTENT, RATING, NOTES) VALUES (#{owner}, #{record.title}, #{record.author}, #{record.translator,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.startedOn,jdbcType=DATE}, #{record.completedOn,jdbcType=DATE}, #{record.content,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.rating,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{record.notes,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
